name: Sierra Madre Ground-Warbler
rangeDescription: Northeastern luzon (philippines)
description: A medium-sized bird of the forest floor from the lowlands to low elevations in the mountains in northeastern Luzon. Fairly stout, with a pale lower bill, long legs, and large feet.

name: River Prinia
rangeDescription: Locally in niger, chad, and northern cameroon (status unknown)
description: An active, slender, unstreaked warbler with a long graduated tail that is sometimes cocked. Gray-brown above and pale below, with a distinctive pale eyebrow.

name: Gibberbird
rangeDescription: Stony plains of central australia
description: Brightly colored, terrestrial songbird with upright posture found in arid stony plains of central Australia. Grayish brown above, yellow below, with yellow face and notably pale eye (Yellow Chat male has a completely yellow head).

name: Ethiopian Thrush
rangeDescription: Highlands of eritrea and ethiopia
description: A long-legged short-tailed thrush with brown upperparts, heavily spotted buff underparts, and a strongly marked face. In flight, shows distinctive large buff patches in the broad wings.

name: Liben Lark
rangeDescription: Southern ethiopia (liben plain) and highlands of northwestern somalia
description: Looks superficially similar to a typical lark, but a careful look reveals an odd shape: a flat, triangular head, a chunky bill, a long neck, and a relatively short tail. There is a beautiful scalloped pattern on the back and thick streaking on the breast.

name: Black-backed Forktail
rangeDescription: Rocky streams of northern india to myanmar, southwestern china, and northwestern thailand
description: Black-and-white stream-dweller with a long, elegant tail. One of many similar forktails in its range.

name: Torresian Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: New guinea, including aru islands (off southwestern new guinea) and adjacent islands, to northern and northeastern australia
description: Large, predominantly white pigeon with black wing feathers. Tip of the tail also black.

name: White-faced Starling
rangeDescription: Forest of wet zone of southwestern sri lanka
description: Small, dark-backed starling with lightly streaked, gray underparts and noticeable white face. Found in pairs and small groups within the canopy of forest in the lowlands and foothills.

name: Green Ibis
rangeDescription: Lowlands of costa rica to northeastern argentina and brazil
description: All-dark wading bird with a curved bill and short legs, giving it a rather dumpy look. Dark green overall with shimmering emerald and bronzy iridescence that can be stunning in good light.

name: Short-tailed Woodstar
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of southwestern ecuador and northwestern peru
description: Tiny hummingbird with a very short tail found in arid scrub and desert in western Ecuador and northwestern Peru. Male has glittering violet “beard” that is bordered by white above and below.

name: Sula Hanging-Parrot
rangeDescription: Banggai and sula islands (off eastern sulawesi)
description: A tiny stub-tailed green parrot with a golden-bronze back, a narrow red throat, a bright red rump, and a small red shoulder patch. Juveniles are duller and more poorly marked.

name: Nimba Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Humid forest of eastern sierra leone to liberia and southern ivory coast
description: A rainforest flycatcher that is completely dark gray. Found very locally in the canopy and upper middle levels of lowland rainforest.

name: Running Coua
rangeDescription: Semiarid lowland forest of southwestern madagascar
description: Long-tailed, long-legged understory bird. Bare facial skin is blue and pink.

name: Green-tailed Emerald
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern venezuela (falcón to lara, sucre, and northern monagas)
description: Small, compact, short-billed and short-tailed hummingbird with green tail. Male all glittering green; female green above and gray below with dark cheek, white eyeline, and white-tipped tail.

name: Jamaican Pewee
rangeDescription: Jamaica
description: A small, plain woodland species often found flycatching from exposed perches at middle levels in the forest; often flicks tail once upon landing. Note that this species has relatively inconspicuous wingbars and no eyering.

name: Velvet-purple Coronet
rangeDescription: Western andes of southwestern colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: This medium-sized hummingbird looks all blackish in poor light, but at the right angle, it turns into a dazzling gem with a purple belly and crown, turquoise sides, and greenish wing coverts. Note bright white flashes in the tail.

name: Qilian Bluetail
rangeDescription: Breeds in north-central china (northeastern qinghai, northern gansu, shanxi, and beijing); wintering range remains to be elucidated
description: A newly described species endemic (at least as a breeder) to a few pockets of northern China. Essentially visually identical to Red-flanked Bluetail: adult male is sky-blue above and pale below, with orange sides and a small white eyebrow.

name: Western Striolated-Puffbird
rangeDescription: Western amazonia: ecuador southward to bolivia and east, south of the amazon river, to brazil west of the rio madeira
description: Chunky, bull-headed puffbird of lowland and foothill rainforest east of the Andes to far western Brazil. Underparts are pale with dark, vertical streaks.

name: Black-chinned Yuhina
rangeDescription: Northern india eastward to central and southeastern china, southward to western myanmar, northern and central laos, vietnam, and far eastern cambodia
description: A small yuhina of open forest environments. Black chin is not very noticeable, but the black crest is.

name: Golden-crowned Brushfinch
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of central peru (san martín southward to western cusco in the apurímac valley), also local on outlying ridges (cordillera azul, southwestern loreto; cerros del sira, huánuco)
description: This chunky bird is dingy yellow below and dark brownish above with a yellow crown. Sexes similar.
